name: @unitpost/sdk-go
description: Workspace shim for the Go SDK (published as github.com/unitpostcom/unitpost-go).

scripts.test: command -v go >/dev/null 2>&1 && go test ./... || echo 'skip: go not available (run in the dedicated sdks CI job)'
scripts.build: command -v go >/dev/null 2>&1 && go build ./... || echo 'skip: go not available'
